title: CoinGlass 7D exclusive liquidation bounds (no 15M price-linked proxy)
changes: Use only actual CoinGlass 7D upper/lower liquidation levels, regardless of Pionex WebSocket price crossing either boundary.
Disable 15M proxy estimate and its automatic Kline fetching for liquidation/Reward-Risk calculations.
Preserve last-known CoinGlass 7D levels during API errors or aged snapshots; clearly mark stale and suspend RR until successful fresh 7D data.
Keep WebSocket ~300ms quote/chart label synchronization, 1D indicators, BTC/WTI mapping, 00:00 radar reset and all existing drawings unchanged.
requiredDeploy: Overwrite four frontend files; no Cloudflare Worker, R2, or Pionex_WebSocket changes.
